clues.text: At Nebuchadnezzar's golden statue, hearing this with the horn, flute and harp meant everyone must bow down.
Job says the children of the wicked skip about like a flock, singing to the tambourine and this.
Isaiah warns that drunkards have this, the harp, tambourines and wine at their feasts, ignoring the LORD's work.
A psalm of David cries out, "Awake, O harp and this! I will awaken the dawn."
A song of Asaph calls God's people to strike the tambourine and play the sweet-sounding harp and this.
A song for the Sabbath praises God with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of this.
A Hallelujah psalm says to praise God in His sanctuary with the sound of the horn, the harp and this.
